title: Warehouse Operator
site: the Getafe logistics park, in Madrid
summary: Full-time warehouse operator: picking and packing customer orders with a hand scanner, and loading trucks. Rotating morning and afternoon shifts, Monday to Friday.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to finish work with a team under time pressure. What did you do?
questions.looks_for: A real situation, the candidate's own actions, how they worked with others, and the result.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you noticed a safety risk or a mistake at work. What did you do about it?
questions.looks_for: A real situation, that the candidate acted or reported it, and that they put safety before speed.
